label: Local rule-order image gate
title: Which rule-order differences survive a first update?
summary: Complete seven-bit local tables show that a Rule-54 prefix removes one of thirteen Rule-54/110 order-sensitive intermediate words but leaves twelve; Rules 30 and 90 leave all thirteen accessible.
takeaway: A prefix filters later rule order through its reachable local image. This proves full-line map difference, not an advantage in recurrence, control or complexity.
